answer: Each interaction contributes to EigenTrust according to its age-weighted, reciprocity-adjusted trust, while reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life. An identity must therefore provide sustained honest service to build durable influence. Freshly spawned sybil identities have almost no trusted incoming weight, so their eigenvector centrality remains near zero; reciprocal transitivity cannot bootstrap them into consensus. Names such as lagoon or crystal do not change this, and each tide of evaluation tests accumulated trust.
